channel.title: Pier & Point · Mission Rock Square
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Mission Rock Square (Mission Rock), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Mission Rock Square: The March 2012 proposal gives the square as 1.32 acres in its parcel table and labels it 0.7 acres in its block plan; the Port's January 2018 memo says 1.1 acres. No source read reports the square built or assigns it to a phase, and the Port's June 2026 Phase 2 report does not mention it. The Board of Supervisors' own records date the Mission Rock DDA approval (Resolution 42-18) to February 13, 2018 and the final passage of the Development Agreement ordinance (No. 33-18) to February 27, 2018; the Notice of Determination gives March 6, 2018 as the City's approval date and lists the Board's EIR action (File 171286) among its final actions. The Port's fact sheet lists August 15, 2018 as the Development Agreement's effective date, and the Planning page dates the DDA 8/15/2018. The earlier statement that the DDA had been read in full is withdrawn; its section numbers and target dates are no longer cited.

item.title: Correction · Mission Rock Square: Mission Rock Square's record and map shape now say: the planned size is about 1.1 acres (the Port's 2018 report; the 1.32 acres / 57,626 sq ft figure is from the March 2012 proposal), and the program quoted from the 2012 proposal is labelled as such alongside what the adopted Design Controls (Sec. 3.3) require. The sentence saying an interim plaza built with Phase 1 occupies the north part was removed (the 2019 submittal only planned two interim plazas south of Parcels B and F); 'unbuilt' is dated to the Port's June 2026 update; the Draft EIR garage is no longer called optional; Blocks B and J are added to the blocks one street from the square; the statements that the lots match the plan within 3% and that the square is an 'elongated hexagon' are corrected or flagged in a new dated note; the Jan 30, 2018, Oct 10, 2023 and March 11, 2025 Port Commission actions cite the minutes and misquoted wording was corrected; and source citations were fixed. The shape is unchanged.

item.title: Correction · Mission Rock Square: The Jan 30, 2018 approval milestone cited 'Resolutions 18-03, 18-04'. Port sources number the Design Controls resolution differently (the Jan 26, 2018 staff report requested it as 18-04; the Sept 2019 Port memo numbers it 18.05), and the Jan 30, 2018 minutes record Resolutions 18-03 to 18-10 as adopted, so the milestone now cites that range.

item.title: Milestone · Mission Rock Square: The Notice of Determination gives March 6, 2018 as the date the City 'decided to carry out or approve the project' and lists the Board of Supervisors' final actions, including File No. 171286 (affirming the Planning Department's certification of the Final EIR) and File No. 180092 (the DDA); it was filed March 9, 2018. The Board's own records date two of the other approvals earlier: Resolution 42-18 (the DDA, File 180092) was adopted February 13, 2018, and Ordinance 33-18 (the Development Agreement, File 171313) was finally passed February 27, 2018. The Port's Oct 2023 report calls No. 33-18 a Resolution and its June 2026 report an Ordinance; the Board's file shows an ordinance (Mar 6, 2018)
item.description: The Notice of Determination gives March 6, 2018 as the date the City 'decided to carry out or approve the project' and lists the Board of Supervisors' final actions, including File No. 171286 (affirming the Planning Department's certification of the Final EIR) and File No. 180092 (the DDA); it was filed March 9, 2018. The Board's own records date two of the other approvals earlier: Resolution 42-18 (the DDA, File 180092) was adopted February 13, 2018, and Ordinance 33-18 (the Development Agreement, File 171313) was finally passed February 27, 2018. The Port's Oct 2023 report calls No. 33-18 a Resolution and its June 2026 report an Ordinance; the Board's file shows an ordinance (Mar 6, 2018). Source: SF Planning, 2018-03-09; Port of San Francisco, 2023-10-06; Port of San Francisco, 2026-06-05; San Francisco Board of Supervisors, 2018-02-13; San Francisco Board of Supervisors, 2018-02-27.
